{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Confirm the counts and conversion rate
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
converted_count = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_count / n_loyal

# Print all required values
print("Number of loyal orders:", n_loyal)
print("Number of converted loyal orders:", converted_count)
print("Conversion rate (fraction):", conversion_rate)"}
